line: Your family called twice. I said you arrived. The second time, I made it sound convincing.

line: Your photograph. And that bag: nobody returning to this city carries it with both hands.

line: They think the sponsorship is settled. Is it?

line: Three nights. C150. After that we discuss the word temporary.

line: Help with supper and we can call it C100. I do not charge family for advice. Yet.

speaker: Sifa
line: Pass those cups. The office asked my neighbour for a processing fee. The notice said applications were free.

speaker: Sifa
line: She paid. Then they asked her daughter to sign for money she never received.

speaker: Sifa
line: The Opportunity Fund. Blue shutters. A man outside knew her name before she introduced herself.

speaker: Sifa
line: Keep your receipts. And eat. Suspicion is not supper.

line: Have you eaten?

line: Take the signed application. Leave the original certificate here. Copies can travel. Originals stay safe.

line: If somebody changes the destination, call me. Being polite does not make them your employer.

line: You look like the scholarship queue has already tired you out.
